decisions.reason: The waste-oil-to-energy plant is a flagship built on the core business, so management would likely keep carrying it despite no visible results since 2019, but its absence from the website in 2020–2021 suggests performance below aspiration and makes withdrawal a near coin-flip.

The plastic-to-fuel plant was only ever mentioned briefly and has shown no presence or traction for several years, which signals a persistent shortfall that would push a small venture-building firm with limited slack to search for better uses of its engineering resources and redeploy them.
